name: Sobrescobio (Spain)
description: Green field charged at the centre with a yellow tower surmounted by a red fleur-de-lis and issuing a red spike, the figures of the municipal arms of Sobrescobio.
history: Municipal flag of Sobrescobio; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: tower with a red fleur-de-lis above and a red spike below
